title: Config
description:
project settings from gargoyle.toml, every field has a default,
so an empty file is valid

dir.description: directory containing the check files, relative to the repo root

Confidence.description: How sure you are this is a real problem, from 0.0 to 1.0.

FailOn.description: lowest severity that fails a review

FilesConfig.description: which files are reviewed at all

exclude.description: glob patterns of files never to review, like generated code

ReviewConfig.description: how a review runs and when it fails

base.description:
branch or commit to compare against,
detected from the remote default branch when unset

fail_on.description: lowest severity that makes a review exit with code 1

max_tokens.description: token budget for a whole review run

min_confidence.description: drop findings below this confidence, a check can override it

tasks.description: how checks are split into review tasks

TaskMode.description: how checks are split into review tasks

oneOf.description:
one task per group of files, with every check that applies to them,
the diff is read once, so it's the cheapest

one task per check, each check gets the reviewer's full attention,
but the diff is read once per check
